title: Internal-Hom tensor criterion for lisse adic cohomology
statement:
Let $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, let $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite inside a fixed algebraic closure $\Qlb$, and let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme. Use the raw rationalized category $D^b_c(T,E)$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] or its common-finite-stage category $D^b_c(T,\Qlb)$ of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]; write $\Lambda$ for the chosen field stage. Tensor, unit $\Lambda_T$ and internal Hom are the completed-integral, rationalized and common-stage operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and cohomology is the standard constructible cohomology. Lisse in the heart means pro-etale locally a finite direct sum of the coefficient unit, with rank zero and varying local rank allowed, as in [lem-tw-lisse-rational-realization].

For $K\in D^b_c(T,\Lambda)$ put $K^\vee=R\mathcal Hom_T(K,\Lambda_T)$, and suppose $K^\vee$ belongs to this category. Suppose that for every $N\in D^b_c(T,\Lambda)$ the canonical evaluation comparison
$$c_{K,N}:K^\vee\otimes^L N\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_T(K,N)$$
is an isomorphism, where $c_{K,N}$ is the tensor--Hom transpose of $K^\vee\otimes^L N\otimes^L K\to N$ obtained from evaluation and symmetry. Then every $\mathcal H^j(K)$, $j\in\mathbf Z$, is lisse of finite rank. No lisse integral lattice on all of $T$ is assumed.

source.place: Definition 3.3 (lisse = dualizable), Theorem 6.2(2), Corollary 6.3 and Corollary 6.11; comparison Theorem 7.7 and Lemma 7.9. Raw rationalization: Bhatt--Scholze Proposition 6.8.14(2), rather than an assumed Karoubi completion. The evaluation-comparison hypothesis is the closed-monoidal criterion for dualizability; this is an agent formulation of their consequence.
